question: Which district is older, Stonecairn or Coldharbour, and how many years older is it than the other?

tool_calls.name: lookup
tool_calls.arguments: {"query": "Stonecairn district founded established year age current profile"}

matches.title: Stonecairn district profile (2025)
matches.text: Stonecairn lies on the Cairn Water and was founded in 1837. The 2025 census counted 14,926 residents, up from 15,473 at the 2020 census, on an area of 1,742.3 square kilometres. The district runs 9 schools with 2,017 pupils enrolled in the 2025/26 school year. Its 2025 budget was 2,884.6 million tenge, and it maintains 506.8 km of paved road. Households used 1,062 megalitres of water in 2025.

matches.title: Ossford district profile (2025)
matches.text: Ossford has 14 schools, which enrolled 4,390 pupils for the 2025/26 school year. The district, founded in 1903, stretches along the Oss over 846.2 square kilometres and keeps 388.9 km of paved road. Census population: 31,560 in 2020 and 30,982 in 2025. Households used 2,418 megalitres of water during 2025, and the district's 2025 budget amounted to 5,117.8 million tenge.

matches.title: Tarnvale district profile (2025)
matches.text: Tarnvale lies on the Tarn and was founded in 1854. The 2025 census counted 71,388 residents, up from 67,214 at the 2020 census, on an area of 2,106.9 square kilometres. The district runs 29 schools with 10,652 pupils enrolled in the 2025/26 school year. Its 2025 budget was 12,960.3 million tenge, and it maintains 944.7 km of paved road. Households used 5,207 megalitres of water in 2025.

matches.title: Brightwater district profile (2025)
matches.text: Brightwater has 17 schools, which enrolled 6,241 pupils for the 2025/26 school year. The district, founded in 1889, stretches along the Bright over 912.4 square kilometres and keeps 455.0 km of paved road. Census population: 39,902 in 2020 and 44,675 in 2025. Households used 3,315 megalitres of water during 2025, and the district's 2025 budget amounted to 7,733.9 million tenge.

matches.title: Lindenmoor district profile (2025)
matches.text: Lindenmoor has 13 schools, which enrolled 4,115 pupils for the 2025/26 school year. The district, founded in 1911, stretches along the Linden over 1,015.7 square kilometres and keeps 402.3 km of paved road. Census population: 27,736 in 2020 and 29,051 in 2025. Households used 2,151,400 cubic metres of water during 2025, and the district's 2025 budget amounted to 4,870.4 million tenge.
